title: Seam: one request opens a record — a record-page payload (record + related counts and first rows + field access + lock) and an app-scoped metadata bundle, so a record open is 2–3 requests instead of 23–45 serialized in three stages
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed from the record-page epic #26676 as a sub-issue after the maintainer's 「别人的界面很丝滑，但是我们的界面总觉得卡顿，云端更卡」 and the seat's measurement (2026-10-29). Ruling: 「立…B（接缝卡：记录页一次取齐 + 元数据打包）两张卡，p1」. A `Seam:` card: the producer is the REST surface (`packages/rest` / `plugin-hono-server`, the data and metadata routes), the consumer is the console's data layer (`ui/packages/data-objectstack`) and the record page; the seat that claims it declares both ends. The client-side waste on the same path is #27626.

## Measured

Local (console `main` `273137d227`, dev mode, HotCRM on `localhost:4001`): opening one contact = **45 requests cold / 23 warm, in three serial stages** — ① the record (`GET /data/crm_contact?populate=…`) + `security/explain` ×2 + `approvals/requests`; ② after the record arrives (+130 ms of client work): one `GET /meta/object/<child>` per related object (9 on a contact), `field-access` ×4, the approvals lock; ③ after the metadata arrives: **one `GET /data/<child>?top=1&filter=…` count probe per related list (10 on a contact)** + attachments + the related rows query + the account. Locally each stage is tens of milliseconds; the drawer is visible at 300 ms.

Cloud (`huayan.objectos.app`, Cloudflare colo ARN, h2, prod bundle 2.2 MB JS in 93 scripts): the same endpoints cost **0.5–1.4 s each when called alone** (`GET /api/v1/runtime/config`, 293 bytes: 555 / 604 / 729 / 1068 / 1377 ms over five sequential calls; `GET /meta/app` 0.9–1.8 s; `GET /meta/view` 1.8–3.8 s; no `cache-control`, no `server-timing`). The HotCRM contacts list route fired **42 API calls** on load, of which `auth/me/localization` 8.2 s, `packages` 7.9 s, `sys_inbox_message` 7.5 s, `meta/dashboard` 6.1 s, `meta/object/sys_user` 5.3 s, `data/crm_contact` 5.3 s — the same calls that take ~1 s alone take 5–8 s when fifteen of them run at once, and the list had not rendered after 50 s. A three-stage, 23-request record open on that path is a multi-second wait by arithmetic alone.

Linear, Attio and Twenty open a record with one aggregated request (counts and permissions ride with the record), load metadata once at boot, and prefetch on hover.

## Target

1. **A record-page payload endpoint** (shape to be designed by the claiming seat and recorded under `packages/spec/contracts/**`): `GET /api/v1/data/<object>/<id>/page` (or a `query` body) returns in ONE response — the record with its populated lookups; for every related list the console would draw (the inbound lookups, in the object's declared order) the count and the first N rows (N = 3, the compact panel's face) with the related-list columns; the caller's field access for the record; the approval lock state; the record's security verdict (`explain`) for the actions the header draws. One request, one round trip, one server-side transaction.
2. **An app-scoped metadata bundle**: `GET /api/v1/meta/app/<appId>/bundle` returns the app, its navigation, every object the app's navigation and those objects' inbound relations reach, their views, pages and dashboards, with an ETag; the console loads it once per session and sends `If-None-Match` after. Today's per-object `GET /meta/object/<name>` stays for Studio and for objects outside the bundle.
3. **The console consumes both**: the record page (split pane, overlay, full page, #27524 / #27545) opens from the page payload with no second stage; stepping ↓ ↑ prefetches the next and previous records' payloads; the per-related `top=1` count probes, the per-open child metadata loads and the separate `field-access` / `lock` / `explain` calls on open retire (startup posture: no dual path kept).
4. **Server-side observability for the cloud reading**: the REST layer emits `Server-Timing` (db, meta, total) on every response, so the next measurement separates origin time from the network path; metadata responses carry `Cache-Control` + `ETag`.
5. Clause-②: yes (new REST routes, declared in the spec contracts); Metadata-protocol: added (the bundle's shape).

## File surface

Producer: `packages/rest/src/**` (routes), `packages/plugin-hono-server/**` (wiring), `packages/spec/contracts/**` (the two shapes), `packages/objectql` only if a batched count query is needed, tests beside, changeset. Consumer: `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` + `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (prefetch), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx` + `RelatedCardStack.tsx` (counts and rows from the payload), tests beside, changeset.

## Acceptance

1. Contract tests for both shapes; a console test that a record open issues exactly one page-payload request (plus at most one metadata bundle on a cold session) and zero `top=1` probes.
2. The cloud reading re-run by the epic seat on `huayan.objectos.app` after landing: record open under 1 s warm, list route under 3 s cold, with `Server-Timing` in the PR body.
3. The epic seat verifies in the console preview before ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」).
